projects.title: Recipe Organiser
bullets: Implemented a menu-driven recipe organiser in Python using functions and collections as a contribution to a team course project.
Documented how recipe records are added, searched, and updated; tested representative inputs and recorded expected outputs.

projects.title: Truth-Table Explorer
bullets: Translated discrete mathematical definitions into Python functions for a truth-table explorer as part of a team course project.
Tested the Python implementation of the truth-table explorer against hand-worked cases for the team project.
